study type: Case-control (ex vivo) and laboratory (in vitro) study
exposure: DBP expression levels (in placentas and manipulated in HTR-8/SVneo cells)
conditioned media from HTR-8/SVneo cells with modified DBP expression
cohort: Placental tissues were collected from preeclampsia patients and normotensive pregnant women with placenta previa controls; human HTR-8/SVneo and HUVEC cell lines were used for in vitro experiments.
finding: DBP expression is significantly increased in the placentas of preeclampsia patients, and DBP inhibits endothelial cell function by decreasing VEGFR-2 phosphorylation, thereby contributing to preeclampsia development.
